Watering Can Refill Route

Enter the watering-can capacity and each plant's water amount, mark which plants have a tap before them, then press “Plan refill stops” to get refill stops, the amount left after each plant, and the fewest refill stops.

Watering-can capacity

1–20,000 ml. The can starts full.

Watering route

1–60 plants. One short name per plant (1–24 characters, first character a letter or digit); duplicates are not allowed. Amount 1–20,000 ml; tick the box when there is a tap before that plant to refill to full.

The sample is fixed placeholder data (1,000 ml can; A, B, C, D need 350, 300, 300, 500 ml; taps before B and C); press “Plan refill stops” to compute it.
